title: Double Drip Banana Ice Nic Salt 10ml E-Liquid
description: Double Drip Banana Ice offers a smooth and indulgent vape that blends ripe Banana flavour with a crisp Menthol finish. The Banana is rich and sweet with a naturally creamy profile, while the icy layer on the exhale adds freshness and keeps the overall flavour from becoming too heavy. It’s a deliciously distinctive combination that’s both mellow and refreshing. This nicotine salt e-liquid is blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio for optimal performance with MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits, including pod systems, refillable vapes , vape pens , and compact starter devices . The nic salt formulation ensures fast-acting nicotine delivery with a smooth and comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, Double Drip Nic Salts are available in a wide range of bold and satisfying flavour profiles to suit everyday vaping. Double Drip are one of the most celebrated and influential e-liquid brands in the UK and the masterminds of some of the most iconic vape flavours ever made. Vibrant, authentic, and highly inventive flavours are a hallmark of all Double Drip vape juices, and this newest collection of truly timeless flavours in smooth, satisfying nic salts won’t disappoint.
